name: ESSEC Business School, Global MBA

class_size.note: Class size not published on the programme page.

tuition_total.note: Official tuition not found on essec.edu (programme page's Financing tab is empty in the served HTML; brochure gated behind a form). Third-party sites quote EUR 55,000 for September 2027: NOT used. Early Bird award EUR 8,000 for applications closing 26 Oct 2026 and 23 Nov 2026; application fee EUR 130.

mandatory_fees_total.note: Only the EUR 130 application fee is published.

living_budget_total.note: No school living budget published on the pages read.

scholarship.note: Other categories listed without amounts (European nationals, International Experience, Women Leaders, High Potential, Diversity & Inclusion, Sustainable Leaders, Digital Transformers, Innovation & Entrepreneurship). No share of class published.

base_salary.note: Employment report (25-26) is gated behind a lead form (Marketo); not downloaded. Landing page states only: per the last Career Survey, 74% of graduates changed sector and 97% changed function (an older page, https://info.essec.edu/GlobalMBA-EmploymentReport.html, says 60% and 93%).

profile.note: '100% International Cohort' as written by the school; average work experience 6 years from the key-facts box.

notes: Thin official data: tuition, living budget and the whole employment report are not public without a form. To re-read in a browser (form) or ask the school.
